fullDescription: A high-end industrial and corporate portfolio style guide featuring a 'Porto de Itapoá' aesthetic. Characterized by a sophisticated forest green color palette (#007651), heavy uppercase typography, and immersive image cards. The design uses a clean white backdrop with minimalist accents, focusing on logistics, supply chain, and professional services. Key features include grayscale-to-color hover transitions, slide-up micro-interactions, and a structured bento-style grid for service presentation. Suitable for industrial, fintech, maritime, and large-scale enterprise websites.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, authoritative corporate portfolio design utilizing a deep green and white palette, bold uppercase headings, and interactive image-based service cards with smooth reveal animations.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a design system based on 'Open Sans'. Use #007651 for primary branding and #022C22 for main text. Headings must be 'font-black' (800 weight), uppercase, with tight tracking (-1.2px for large titles). Labels should use 10px font size with wide tracking (3px). Backgrounds are primarily white with #F0FAF5 used for borders and light accents. Interactive elements should feature a transition timing of 500ms using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Images in cards must have a 'grayscale' filter applied by default, which transitions to 'grayscale-0' on hover. Overlays should use rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.6) and darken slightly on interaction.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Section Container
The section should have a max-width of 1280px (max-w-screen-xl) with horizontal padding of 24px (px-6) and vertical padding of 128px (py-32). The background is pure white.

### Header Section
A flex-container with justify-between and items-end alignment. Left side: A vertical stack containing a small uppercase label with 3px tracking, a 48px uppercase bold heading, and a description paragraph. The description must have a 4px solid left border in #007651 and 32px of left padding (pl-8). Right side: A 'Ver Todos' button/link with 12px font size, 1.2px tracking, and 48px/20px padding (px-12 py-5).

### Services Grid
A grid layout with grid-cols-1 on mobile and grid-cols-2 on desktop. Use a gap of 32px (8 units). Each card has a fixed height of 450px and a 4px solid border in #F0FAF5.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Service Card — A 450px high card with an image background and an animated text overlay.
Create a relative container with overflow-hidden. Place an absolute full-bleed image with grayscale-100. Over the image, place an absolute overlay with background rgba(0, 56, 38, 0.6). The content should be flex-col and justify-end, with 48px padding (p-12). The description paragraph within the card must be hidden (opacity-0) and translated 24px down (translate-y-6) by default. On group-hover: the image becomes color (grayscale-0), the overlay darkens, the description becomes visible (opacity-100) and slides up to its natural position (translate-y-0). Include a bottom-aligned 'call to action' with a 3.6px tracking and a small arrow icon.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use 'Open Sans' for all typography to maintain the corporate look. MUST ensure the grayscale filter on images is exactly 100% until hovered. MUST maintain the 32px left padding on the intro paragraph to create the 'asymmetric' alignment look. DO NOT use rounded corners; the aesthetic depends on sharp, 90-degree angles for a professional, industrial feel.
